t: A complete Raspberry Pi 5 computer tucked inside a glowing mechanical keyboard.
steps: Buy the Raspberry Pi 500+ Desktop Kit from a maker shop to get the mouse, power supply and cable in one box.
Connect a monitor with the micro-HDMI cable.
Plug in the mouse and the 5 A USB-C power supply.
Press the power key at the top right of the keyboard.
Follow the setup screens to join Wi-Fi and create your account.
A blank drive needs Raspberry Pi OS from the free Raspberry Pi Imager app.
Open Thonny and run a short Python program that prints your name.
meta: Open Code. From $410. A few stores.
